answer: Admission passes are issued as blind signatures that need three of five issuers, so no issuer knows which pass belongs to which applicant and passes cannot be linked or sold. A farm must collect three blind signatures per alias from issuers who cannot see what they are signing, and a leaked pass cannot be traced back to a buyer. The bridge of the design is public, the terrace of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the river of honest work is what finally pays.
